identity.en: A slender nineteen-year-old Chinese young woman, a student in 1930s Republican-era China

face.en: Oval face with soft rounded cheeks and a delicate jaw, large dark wary eyes, straight fine eyebrows, small straight nose, thin lips held lightly closed
face.text: 鹅蛋脸，眼睛偏大带戒备，细直眉，薄唇

hair.en: Centre-parted black hair in two long braids tied at the tips with faded red string
hair.text: 中分黑发，两条长辫，辫梢系褪色红绳

build.en: A thin frame with shoulders drawn slightly inward
build.text: 身形单薄，肩膀习惯性往内缩

top.en: a dark navy-blue cotton student tunic with a plain white collar washed pale
top.text: 藏青学生装，衣领洗得发白

bottom.en: a dark mid-calf pleated skirt, white cotton socks and black cloth shoes
bottom.text: 深色及膝百褶裙、白棉袜、黑布鞋

details.en: the tip of one of her long black braids, tied with faded red string
the plain white collar of her dark navy-blue cotton tunic, washed pale
the dark navy-blue cotton cuff, faded and slightly frayed at the edge
black cloth shoes with a single strap and white cotton socks

identity.en: A lean Chinese man in his late twenties, a former soldier in 1930s Republican-era China
identity.text: 二十七八岁的男人，退伍军人，民国

face.en: Gaunt angular face with high sharp cheekbones and hollow cheeks, a square jaw, flat dark eyes under a heavy brow, a two-inch old scar across the right brow ridge, long healed, thin, flat and slightly paler than the skin, a straight thin mouth
face.text: 脸瘦，颧骨高，右眉骨一道两寸长的旧疤

hair.en: Short cropped black hair with closely trimmed sides

top.en: a washed-out grey military wool greatcoat with the collar turned up
top.text: 洗得发灰的军呢大衣，领子拉起

bottom.en: the long skirt of the greatcoat over dark wool trousers and worn, creased leather boots
bottom.text: 大衣下摆、深色呢裤、磨损的皮靴

details.en: his short cropped black hair at the crown
the turned-up collar of his washed-out grey military wool greatcoat
the grey wool greatcoat cuff, pilled and worn shiny
worn leather boots creased across the instep

identity.en: An elderly Chinese ferryman around seventy on a Jiangnan river in 1930s Republican-era China
identity.text: 七十岁上下的老船夫，民国江南

face.en: Deeply weathered dark brown face with sunken cheeks and prominent cheekbones, the left eye clouded a pale milky white while the right stays sharp, sparse grey stubble, a nearly toothless mouth in a faint weary smile
face.text: 面皮深褐、沟壑纵横，左眼白翳，牙只剩几颗

hair.en: Thin grey hair cropped close to a balding scalp
hair.text: 稀疏灰白短发，头顶半秃

build.en: A heavily hunched back bent like a drawn bow, thick gnarled hands
build.text: 背驼得像拉满的弓，手掌粗厚变形

top.en: a faded indigo padded cotton jacket with frayed cuffs and mismatched patches
top.text: 褪色靛蓝棉袄，袖口磨破，打着补丁

bottom.en: rolled dark cotton trousers and worn straw sandals
bottom.text: 挽起的深色布裤、旧草鞋

details.en: his thin grey hair cropped close to a balding scalp
the frayed collar of his faded indigo padded cotton jacket
the faded indigo cuff, frayed and patched in mismatched thread
worn straw sandals frayed at the weave on bare weathered feet

identity.en: A plump Chinese travelling peddler in his mid-forties in 1930s Republican-era China
identity.text: 四十来岁的胖货郎，民国

face.en: Round full face with fat cheeks that push the eyes into thin creased slits when he grins, a broad flat nose, a wide mouth, a double chin, sweat beading on a high forehead
face.text: 圆脸，笑起来眼睛眯成缝，满头是汗

hair.en: Thinning black hair receding from a high forehead

build.en: A round soft body on stout short legs

top.en: a short russet cotton jacket with the sleeves rolled to the elbow and a cloth sash tied at the waist
top.text: 赭色短褐，袖子挽到肘，腰间束带

bottom.en: loose dark cotton trousers and black cloth shoes

details.en: his thinning black hair at the temples
the sweat-darkened collar of his short russet cotton jacket
the russet cotton sleeve rolled to the elbow with a permanent crease
black cloth shoes under loose dark cotton trousers
